notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
Some crucial functionalities were added to the Ahlman Mansion:
[list]
[*]M for toggling music on / off
[*]LEFT MOUSE BUTTON for picking up / dropping objects
[*]RIGHT MOUSE BUTTON for throwing objects
[*]MOUSE WHEEL for rotating objects
[*]Q and E for turning objects around
[/list]

Added missing credits to pickable 3D objects.
Also fixed Glitch character from leaking to game selection menu.
